_approach: Private School Piano's refined, mellow read: kick pulled back to a single soft hit on beat 1 (sometimes skipped), a whisper-quiet shaker, a soft rim on 2 and 4 standing in for the brushed backbeat, and only one gentle log-drum (congaLow) answer per bar - everything is understated because the (absent, melodic) piano carries the track. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
